title: OpenCode Metrics
description: OpenCode usage metrics: sessions, messages, duration, tools, tokens, cost, models, and native logs.

panels.title: Token Analytics
panels.description: Per-model breakdown of cache_read / total tokens. Window pinned to 5m for stability against plugin-otel's ~60s push interval.

panels.title: Cache Hit Ratio — Selected Range
panels.description: Cumulative cacheRead / total tokens ratio across the entire time range selected in the timepicker. Long-window average — smooths over individual session bursts. Pair with the 'Last 1h' panel to compare overall vs recent cache effectiveness.

panels.title: Cache Hit Ratio — Last 1h
panels.description: Recent cumulative cacheRead / total tokens ratio over the last 1 hour. Uses last_over_time − min_over_time (within-window growth) instead of rate(); avoids the NaN dips that the older 5m rate() form produced when plugin-otel's ~60s push interval left rate windows with too few samples.

panels.title: Cache Hit Ratio by Model — Last 1h
panels.description: Per-model cumulative cacheRead / total tokens ratio over the last 1 hour. Uses last_over_time − min_over_time (within-window growth) instead of rate(); compare prompt cache effectiveness across models without NaN dips from rate-window sparsity.
